title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
description:
Given a string `s`, return the length of the longest **substring** (contiguous block of characters) in which **no character appears twice**.

`s` may contain letters, digits, symbols and spaces, and may be empty.
constraints: s consists of printable ASCII characters (codes 32 to 126)

examples.explanation: "mzuxt" has five different characters. Any longer block repeats m or t.
Every block longer than one character repeats 'a'.
The empty string has no characters.
